SELECT SUM (CHARGEFROMPREPAID) / 1000000 AS "Data 2G Revenue"
  FROM (SELECT A.CALLINGCELLID,
  A.ACCESSNETWORKADDRESS,
  A.CHARGEFROMPREPAID,
  A.TOTALFLUX,
  CASE
  WHEN SUBSTR (A.CALLINGCELLID, 1, 5) = '56F92'
  THEN
  '4G'
  WHEN A.CALLINGCELLID IS NULL
  AND A.ACCESSNETWORKADDRESS LIKE '102.64.73%'
  THEN
  '4G'
  ELSE
  B.NET_TYPE
  END
  NET_TYPE
  FROM (SELECT CALLINGCELLID, ACCESSNETWORKADDRESS, TOTALFLUX
  FROM OCS_DATA) A
  LEFT OUTER JOIN
  BIB_ADM.BASE_STATION_NEW_2020 B
  ON A.CALLINGCELLID = TO_CHAR (B.CGI))
  WHERE NET_TYPE = '2G';
